entries.task_id: mushrooms inc|submitted|an application for an authorisation to the commission in accordance with article 10(1) of regulation (eu) 2015/2283 to place vitamin d2 mushroom powder on the union market as a novel food
entries.description: Mushrooms Inc submitted an application for an authorisation to the Commission in accordance with Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283 to place vitamin D2 mushroom powder on the Union market as a novel food
entries.subject: Mushrooms Inc
entries.object: an application for an authorisation to the Commission in accordance with Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283 to place vitamin D2 mushroom powder on the Union market as a novel food

spans.text: (3) On 21 February 2020, the company Monterey Mushrooms Inc (‘the applicant’) submitted an application for an authorisation to the Commission in accordance with Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283 to place vitamin D2 mushroom powder on the Union market as a novel food.

entries.task_id: original data|submitted|in support of the application
entries.description: original data submitted in support of the application
entries.subject: original data

spans.text: (4) On 21 February 2020, the applicant also made a request to the Commission for the protection of proprietary data for a number of original data submitted in support of the application, namely, data on the identity of vitamin D2 mushroom powder (5), certificates of analysis and batch data (6), the stability reports (7), and the intakes assessment report (8).

entries.task_id: the authority|adopted|its scientific opinion on the ‘safety of vitamin d2 mushroom powder as a novel food pursuant to regulation (eu) 2015/2283 (nf 2019/1471)’ (9) in accordance with article 11 of regulation (eu) 2015/2283
entries.description: the Authority adopted its scientific opinion on the ‘Safety of vitamin D2 mushroom powder as a Novel food pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2015/2283 (NF 2019/1471)’ (9) in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283
entries.subject: the Authority
entries.object: its scientific opinion on the ‘Safety of vitamin D2 mushroom powder as a Novel food pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2015/2283 (NF 2019/1471)’ (9) in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283

spans.text: (6) On 26 April 2022, the Authority adopted its scientific opinion on the ‘Safety of vitamin D2 mushroom powder as a Novel food pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2015/2283 (NF 2019/1471)’ (9) in accordance with Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283.

entries.task_id: the authority|concluded|that the vitamin d2 mushroom powder is safe at the proposed uses and use levels
entries.description: the Authority concluded that the vitamin D2 mushroom powder is safe at the proposed uses and use levels
entries.subject: the Authority
entries.object: that the vitamin D2 mushroom powder is safe at the proposed uses and use levels

spans.text: (7) In its scientific opinion, the Authority concluded that the vitamin D2 mushroom powder is safe at the proposed uses and use levels.

(11) The applicant declared that they held proprietary and exclusive rights of reference to the scientific data on the identity of the novel food, batch analysis information, the respective certificates of analysis and the stability studies at the time they submitted the application.

entries.task_id: their application|is|based on legally obtained information supporting such an authorisation
entries.description: their application is based on legally obtained information supporting such an authorisation
entries.subject: their application
entries.object: based on legally obtained information supporting such an authorisation

spans.text: (13) However, restricting the authorisation of vitamin D2 mushroom powder and the reference to the scientific data contained in the applicant’s file for the sole use by them does not prevent subsequent applicants from applying for an authorisation to place on the market the same novel food provided that their application is based on legally obtained information supporting such an authorisation.

entries.subject: It
entries.object: appropriate that the inclusion of vitamin D2 mushroom powder as a novel food in the Union list of novel foods contains the information referred to in Article 9(3) of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283

spans.text: (14) It is appropriate that the inclusion of vitamin D2 mushroom powder as a novel food in the Union list of novel foods contains the information referred to in Article 9(3) of Regulation (EU) 2015/2283.
